commands.farmingforblockheads.enable.suc: Enabled market group '%s'. Run /reload for changes to take effect.
commands.farmingforblockheads.disable.su: Disabled market group '%s'. Run /reload for changes to take effect.
advancements.farmingforblockheads.lost_i: Shoot a Shipping Balloon out of the air.
farmingforblockheads.configuration.hydra: The chance to get a bonus growth on farmland hydrated by a Watering Can.
farmingforblockheads.configuration.disab: If true, farmland will not become moist from nearby water. Rain and Watering Cans still hydrate farmland.
farmingforblockheads.configuration.exclu: List of groups to disable. Has precedence over includedGroups. 'selling.seeds' for example would disable all seeds from the market.
farmingforblockheads.configuration.inclu: List of groups to enable. 'default' is an alias for the inbuilt defaults (selling.seeds, selling.saplings and selling.fertilizers.minecraft).
